description: This file defines the Base64 class for encoding and decoding data in Base64 format, specifically used within the SourceMap component of the SCSSPHP project. It includes static mappings for encoding and decoding characters and provides methods to perform these conversions.

classes.name: Base64
classes.description: A utility class for Base64 encoding and decoding with mappings specific to SourceMap purposes in SCSSPHP.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value into its Base64 string representation using the internal encoding map.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 character into its integer value using the internal decoding map.
